notebooks.official_information_policy: Gassco tariff, manual, GMDC, and Nyhamna values; SODIR clauses; and Norwegian Tax Administration guidance are frozen, dated teaching snapshots with direct official links and explicit instructions to re-verify current controlling documents. No live endpoint is called during notebook execution. All field, host, price, cost, availability, and economic-case values are synthetic teaching inputs.
known_limitations: The fluid, profiles, host capacity, route selection, prices, costs, and commercial terms are synthetic and are not a real NCS opportunity or operator capacity statement.

The process omits calibrated reservoir and multiphase transient models, dehydration, dew-point and acid-gas units, detailed NGL recovery, equipment maps, reliability, dynamic control, emissions compliance, and produced-water treatment.
Published Nyhamna values are facility- and document-specific examples, not universal or guaranteed-current Gassled specifications.

The tariff addition is a dated classroom screen using selected published unit elements; actual charges require the regulation, booking vintage, route, service, month, quantity basis, agreement, adjustments, and operator confirmation.

The petroleum-tax model is deliberately simplified and excludes field-specific tax bases, loss timing, norm-price detail, finance, transition items, decommissioning, abandonment security, indirect taxes, and eligibility analysis.
The retained validation outputs use pinned NeqSim 3.17.0 because Maven Central DNS was unavailable; normal Colab execution source-builds the recorded current NeqSim master path.
notebooks.documentation_impact: Adds one advanced field-development entry to the main Colab examples catalog and a dedicated maintenance shard; no Java API documentation change is required.
notebooks.issue_handling: No NeqSim defect or actionable Java API gap was exposed by the executed workflow. The current-master Maven failure was an external DNS outage, so no upstream NeqSim issue was opened.
